description: Source code for the WebBridge plugin implementation, including initialization, message handling, WebSocket communication, and plugin registration within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: Registration
classes.description: A JSON container class for registration data, holding event and callsign strings.

methods.name: WebBridge::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebBridge plugin with the provided service, setting configuration and state.

methods.name: WebBridge::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: WebBridge::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebSocket channel if protocol is JSON and not already attached.

methods.name: WebBridge::Invoke
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON-RPC messages, routing registration, unregistration, or forwarding requests.

methods.name: WebBridge::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages, either as new messages or responses to previous requests.
